text: Import a GitHub repository or branch by URL as a source
quote: To add a GitHub repository: More Uploads Import Code and enter the GitHub repository or branch URL.

text: Upload a local code folder as a source
quote: To add a code folder: click More Uploads Import Code Upload folder.

text: Generate images from prompts in seconds using Nano Banana 2
quote: You can create captivating images in seconds with Nano Banana 2. From work, play, or anything in between, Gemini Apps can help you generate and refine images to help bring your imagination to life.

text: Make quick local edits to specific parts of a generated image
quote: Local edits: Making quick and specific changes to parts of an image.

text: Maintain character/person consistency across generated images and blend multiple images together
quote: Character consistency: Maintain the look of a person or character across various generated images, including the ability to combine multiple images to blend scenes or ideas.

text: On Android, invoke Gemini via 'Hey Google' to get help with whatever is currently on screen
quote: On Android, say “Hey Google” to ask Gemini for help with what’s on your screen

text: Run in-depth, real-time research across many sources via Deep Research
quote: You can conduct in-depth and real-time research on almost any subject with Deep Research in Gemini Apps.

text: Schedule recurring actions so Gemini becomes part of daily/weekly/monthly routines
quote: You can make Gemini a part of your daily, weekly, and monthly routines by scheduling recurring actions.

text: Create a custom Gem with its own instructions and requirements
quote: To create a custom Gem to meet your goals, provide info about your request and requirements.

text: Connect to other apps and, with permission, take actions like editing/managing content in them
quote: Gemini Apps can connect to other apps to complete your request and give you more helpful responses. With your permission, Gemini can also help you take actions, like editing and managing your content in other apps.

text: Notebooks provide a continuous chat that remembers sources, instructions, and ongoing discussion
quote: Notebooks provide a continuous chat experience that remembers your sources, instructions, and ongoing discussions.

text: Have a natural, free-flowing voice conversation with Gemini Live, including interrupting it
quote: With Gemini Live, you can have a natural, free-flowing conversation with Gemini. You can even interrupt it like when you want to add more details or change the topic of the conversation.

text: Use keyboard shortcut (Option+Space) to open the Gemini chat window on Mac
quote: you can also use the keyboard shortcut Option + Space to bring up the Gemini chat window after the app is installed and running

text: Get a personalized experience based on memory of past Gemini chats
quote: You can get a personalized experience in Gemini Apps based on: The memory of your past Gemini chats

text: Make plans using Google Maps and Google Flights integrations
quote: Make plans with Google Maps and Google Flights

text: Get quick access to writing, brainstorming, and coding help without opening a web browser
quote: The Gemini app provides quick access to AI features, allowing you to get help with writing, brainstorming, coding, and more, without needing to open a web browser.

text: Organize projects into dedicated notebooks/spaces
quote: you can use notebooks to organize your projects in a dedicated, focused space.

text: Upload documents, spreadsheets, notebooks, photos, and videos to get answers, summaries, and insights
quote: You can upload documents, spreadsheets, notebooks, photos, videos, and more to Gemini Apps to get answers, summaries, and insights about your content.

text: Download generated images at up to 2K resolution with a Google AI plan
quote: Download images at at 2K resolution with a Google AI plan or at 1K without an AI plan.

text: Blend text, images, and video together to create content
quote: Blend text, images, and video to bring your ideas to life.

text: Add sources like personal Gmail, Drive, uploaded files, or NotebookLM notebooks for research
quote: You can change or add other sources, like your personal Gmail or Drive, for your research. You can also upload files and add NotebookLM notebooks.

text: Summarize Gmail emails and create Calendar events or third-party app events to boost productivity
quote: Boost productivity: Summarize emails from Gmail, create events in Google Calendar or third-party apps, or search for content across a variety of productivity apps.

text: Review prompt history and delete Gemini Apps activity, including turning off activity retention
quote: You can review your prompts, delete your Gemini Apps activity, and turn off Keep Activity in My Activity at any time.

text: Receive a personalized Daily Brief digest organized by importance based on personal rhythms
quote: Start your day with a personalized digest from Gemini. Your Daily Brief understands your rhythms and personal preferences to deliver your top priorities, organized by importance.

text: Connect third-party apps to Gemini via Connected Apps
quote: Get started with Connected Apps in Gemini **Important:** For now, Gemini can’t use Connected Apps in Gemini in Google Messages.

text: Talk to Gemini Live without typing and receive verbal responses back
quote: With Gemini Live, you can: * **Talk back and forth:** Talk to Gemini without typing, and Gemini will respond back verbally.

text: Chats and uploaded files in Gemini Apps are not reviewed by humans or used to train generative AI models
quote: Your chats and uploaded files in Gemini Apps won’t be reviewed by human reviewers or otherwise used to improve generative AI models.
